question: Manish Pandey played for which team in IPL 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lucknow Super Giants**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022 ended with Gujarat Titans (GT) lifting the trophy by defeating inaugural champions Rajasthan Royals (RR) at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad.
 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022, was the 15th edition of the professional Twenty20 cricket league established by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• The host country for IPl 2022 was India.
 
• The Orange Cap title winner is Jos Butler (Rajasthan Royals) with Total runs: 863 runs.
 
• The Purple Cap title winner is Yuzvendra Chahal (Rajasthan Royals) with total 27 Wickets.
 
• IPL 2022 Sponsorer was TATA.
